summary:
US-Iran peace talks remain fragile, with mixed signals on a deal keeping oil prices elevated and reigniting inflation concerns that drove the 10-year Treasury yield back to 4.62% mid-week.  
 
<cite index="2-5,2-6">Stocks bounced as oil and long-term yields eased late in the week, but the oil-yield link remains the key lever — higher oil lifts inflation fears, which lifts yields, which pressures equities.
